items.title: An object is R-perfect exactly when it is a finite complex of flat finitely presented modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: statement 是 R-perfect 的结构刻画（等价于有限个 R-平坦有限表现模的复形）。证明两向都不长但都很实：正向先把问题归结到一个 R-平坦有限表现模的伪凝聚性，用「平坦有限表现下降到一个有限生成的模型」把 M 写成 M_0 的基变换，再拿 Noetherian 情形下有限模的伪凝聚性、有限自由消解以及 A_0/R_0 的平坦性把消解基变换回去；反向只做一件实事——把有限自由表示在 tor amplitude 下界处截断，得到全是平坦有限表现模的复形。6 处引用里 4 处同章、2 处跨章，承重演算都在 span 内，引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-structure-relatively-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 21979-21988

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the two-way argument that a finite complex of flat finitely presented modules is pseudo-coherent of finite tor dimension over R and that an R-perfect object is represented by the truncation of a finite free resolution (source lines 21990-22019)
